question: How did Hari Srinivasan and LinkedIn develop their product-management course, and what did they learn about teaching the subject effectively?
expected_points: They created an internal product university after employees reported lacking skills for their jobs.
They found PM couldn’t be taught through frameworks alone; the training needed case studies and concrete examples drawn from LinkedIn’s work.
They later filmed the bootcamp curriculum as a course and opened it up to a wider audience.
evidence_quote: We tried to get from different models and one of the things we really learned was, you can't teach this just through frameworks.
